title: 第2656章 血渊神龙意志第2655章 九龙战天诀
content_zh:
那九扇虚空门户通往的地方，名为血渊龙火池。说是“池”，实则是一片被血渊龙火填满的熔岩空间，池中翻涌的并非寻常岩浆，而是浓郁到近乎液态的血渊龙火精华。灼热的气息从门户中扑面而来，连空气都被烧得扭曲变形，站在门外便已能感受到那股足以熔炼万物的恐怖高温。
林尘没有任何犹豫，率先迈入其中一扇虚空门户。血渊神龙既然提出了考核，他自然要去配合。虽说血渊神龙并未明说第二轮考核能奖励什么资源宝物，但从第一轮的经历来看，林尘拿到的那三根真我龙骨档次已经极高，第二轮的奖励按理说只会更好，不会更差。
况且退一步讲，即便什么奖励都没有，光是进入血渊龙火池接受洗礼，让那强悍的血渊龙火不断焚烧淬炼肉身，本身便是难得的好处。林尘心中对这些账算得很清楚，自然不会错过。
林尘和叶清霜开始历练的速度是最快的，两人几乎是一前一后踏入门户，毫不犹豫。在他们进去好一阵子之后，才有其他人犹犹豫豫地跟过来。显然，各大势力的这些所谓天骄们是想先看看林尘和叶清霜进去之后会不会出什么问题，等确认安全了再跟上。
但他们显然想多了——从外面根本无法窥探到门户内部的情况，里面的景象被一层扭曲的热浪完全隔绝，什么也看不见。犹豫了一段时间后，这帮天骄终于咬咬牙，硬着头皮纷纷冲了进去。
九处通道此刻全部打开，但每一处血渊龙火池一次只能容纳一人进入历练，因此最多也就九个人同时进行考核。
即便只是九个人，问题也不大——或者说问题很大，只是暴露得极快。那些人进去之后没多久，便有人狼狈不堪地从门户中摔了出来，浑身沾满鲜血，衣袍被烧得焦黑破烂，皮肤上布满了触目惊心的灼痕。血渊龙火池对他们造成的杀伤力太强了，大部分人根本无法在其中逗留太久，几乎刚冲进去就被那恐怖的龙火逼得狼狈退出，脸上犹带着惊魂未定的恐惧。
而相比之下，林尘和叶清霜的表现则要比他们惊艳太多。两人进去之后，很长一段时间都没有出来，门户中静悄悄的，既没有惨叫声，也没有被轰飞的动静。这足以说明两人已经稳稳地在其中开始历练了。
至于历练的效果具体如何，外面的人无从得知，但毫无疑问，跟那些刚冲进去就狼狈逃出的天骄相比，完全不是一个层次的存在。
血渊龙火池内，炽热的火焰如同愤怒的巨兽般不断翻涌，将整个空间映成一片刺目的金红色。林尘盘坐于火池中央，面色平静无比，任由那灼热的火焰包裹全身疯狂焚烧，皮肤表面发出“滋滋滋”的响声，甚至已经开始冒起缕缕白烟。
不得不说，血渊龙火池的威力确实强悍，以林尘的肉身强度，踏进来的一瞬间便感知到一股惊人的压迫感从四面八方袭来，几乎要将他彻底吞没。那火焰不仅灼烧肉身，更顺着毛孔往经脉深处钻，仿佛要将每一寸血肉都烧成灰烬。
好在他的肉身结构本就逆天，在异灵火焰的疯狂焚烧之下终究扛过了第一波最猛烈的冲击。扛住了第一轮袭击之后，林尘便开始收获好处了——那狂暴的焚烧之力没能够将他摧毁，反而如同最猛烈的铁锤，在一遍遍锻打中让他的肉身越发精纯。林尘身上的气息越来越强横，用血渊龙火来锤炼体魄，效果比他预想的还要好。他的肉身本来就已经极强，如今在血渊龙火的持续焚烧下，每一块骨骼、每一条经脉都在火焰的淬炼中变得更加致密坚固，隐隐泛起一层暗金色的光泽。
在承受住血渊龙火的焚烧之后，林尘开始尝试更进一步——主动吸收这些火焰。他运转体内的龙血之力，将周围翻涌的龙火一缕缕吸入经脉之中。源源不断的血渊龙火在他体内冲击激荡，如同一条条炽热的火龙在经脉中横冲直撞，换作旁人早就被烧得经脉尽断，林尘却始终面色从容。感知到血渊龙火的强大力量正在被自己一点一点炼化，他嘴角不由得浮现出一抹满意的笑容。
林尘的身上开始浮现出一道道火纹，那是血渊龙火焚烧肉身之后留下的印记，也是吸收龙火的证明。火纹越多，说明他吸收炼化的血渊龙火也就越多，一道道赤金色的纹路在他皮肤表面蔓延开来，如同某种古老而玄奥的图腾。更让林尘颇感意外的是，血渊龙火不仅能锤炼体魄，还对他所修炼的火属性之道有着不小的助益。他当然是精通火系功法的，只是有相当长一段时间没有专门去修炼这方面的功法了，加上最近实力提升极快，火系手段对他来说已不再那么关键。但此刻血渊龙火中蕴含的火系本源之力涌入体内，那股久违的火属性力量重新被点燃，林尘明显能感觉到自己对火焰的掌控力在飞速攀升。
更让他惊喜的是，他发现自己似乎可以控制血渊龙火了。一开始他只是单纯地将龙火吸收到体内炼化，还未能真正驾驭这股力量。但随着时间的推移，林尘发现自己能够调动血渊龙火的威能，心念一动，掌心中便有一缕赤金色的火苗跳跃而出，温顺地在他指尖流转。这意味着他只要吸收足够多的血渊龙火本源，之后自己便能直接释放出血渊龙火，而不再是单纯的被动吸收。
林尘浑身猛然一震，一股可怕的威压自体内释放而出。他直接开启了真我神龙血脉，周身龙血沸腾，体表随之覆盖上一层无极神龙甲。在龙血突破到真我神龙层次之后，无极神龙甲的防御力自然也是水涨船高，龙甲上的纹路更加繁复，光泽也更加深沉内敛。真我神龙之力在体内急速运转，林尘的肉身强度骤然拔升了一个档次，吸收血渊龙火的速度也随之暴涨。他不再像之前那样小心翼翼地一缕一缕牵引，而是直接放开了体内的炼天熔炉，以近乎鲸吞的方式将周围的龙火席卷而来。
然而没过多久，林尘就发现不对劲了。他吸收血渊龙火的速度实在太快，快到这满满一大池子的血渊龙火精华，竟然被他一股脑儿给吸了个干净。原本火焰翻涌的火池转眼间便暗淡下来，只剩池底残留着几缕微弱的火星，连一丝像样的火焰都冒不出来了。
林尘愣了一下，脸上露出一抹尴尬的神色：“怎么回事？才这么点吗？”他还以为血渊龙火会源源不断地涌来，足够他尽情吸收个够，没曾想这么大一池子竟然如此不经吸。
此刻，血渊神殿中的血渊神龙意志，嘴角狠狠地抽搐了一下。理论上来说，一处血渊龙火池中所蕴含的龙火本源已经足够庞大了，寻常天骄进去能吸收掉池中十分之一的量便已是天赋异禀，想要将整池龙火抽空，根本就是不可能的事。然而林尘似乎完全不受这个限制，以一种近乎疯狂的速度在吞噬血渊龙火的本源，更离谱的是，吸收了这么多狂暴的龙火之后他非但没有爆体而亡，反而像个没事人一样坐在那里。光是这一点，就足以让血渊神龙的意志感到不可思议。
血渊神龙的意志分化出一道念头，悄然降临到林尘所在的考核空间中。当他亲眼看到林尘身上散发出的那股强大的火焰气息，以及皮肤上密密麻麻布满的火纹时，饶是这位见多识广的古老存在，也不由得暗暗啧舌。

吸收了如此海量的血渊龙火本源，林尘却始终保持着镇定自若的模样，呼吸平稳，气息沉稳，完全是一副游刃有余的姿态。这一幕深深震撼了血渊神龙，他见过无数惊才绝艳的天骄，但林尘绝对是其中最惊艳的一个，没有之一。
感受到血渊神龙意志的降临，林尘抬起头，朝他咧嘴一笑，那笑容灿烂而坦然，带着几分理所当然的期待：“前辈，既然是考核，那总得考核到底才行啊。我现在都没有血渊龙火了——是不是能从其他地方抽调一些过来，让我继续完成考核？”
闻言，血渊神龙的意志再度狠狠抽搐了一下嘴角。林尘这话的意思，不就是想多吸收一些血渊龙火吗？竟然把理由说得这般冠冕堂皇，倒像是自己在故意为难他似的。但血渊神龙转念一想，似乎也未尝不可。
反正其他正在进行考核的人，他们的表现跟林尘比起来完全就是两个层次的存在，根本不值一提。把资源倾斜给最有潜力的人，本就是秘境历练的潜规则。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
The place that the nine void portals lead to is called the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire Pond. It is said to be a "pool", but it is actually a lava space filled with Blood Abyss Dragon Fire. What surges in the pool is not ordinary magma, but the essence of Blood Abyss Dragon Fire that is so rich that it is almost liquid. The scorching breath rushed in from the door, and even the air was burned and distorted. Standing outside the door, you could already feel the terrifying high temperature that could melt all things.
Lin Chen didn't hesitate and took the lead to step into one of the void portals. Since the Blood Abyss Dragon proposed the assessment, he naturally had to cooperate. Although the Blood Abyss Dragon did not clearly state what resources and treasures would be rewarded in the second round of assessment, judging from the experience in the first round, the three True Self Dragon Bones that Lin Chen received were already of extremely high quality. It stands to reason that the rewards in the second round would only be better, not worse.
Moreover, even if there is no reward, just entering the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire Pool to be baptized and letting the powerful Blood Abyss Dragon Fire continuously burn and temper the body is a rare benefit in itself. Lin Chen calculated these accounts very clearly in his mind, so naturally he would not miss them.
Lin Chen and Ye Qingshuang started training the fastest. They almost entered the door one after the other without hesitation. After they entered for a while, others followed hesitantly. Obviously, these so-called geniuses from the major forces wanted to see if there would be any problems with Lin Chen and Ye Qingshuang after they went in, and then they would follow after they were sure they were safe.
But they obviously thought too much - it was impossible to peek inside the portal from the outside. The scene inside was completely isolated by a layer of twisted heat waves, and nothing could be seen. After hesitating for a while, these geniuses finally gritted their teeth and rushed in one after another.
All nine passages are open at this moment, but each Blood Abyss Dragon Fire Pool can only accommodate one person at a time to enter the experience, so at most nine people can take the assessment at the same time.
Even if there are only nine people, the problem is not big - or rather, the problem is big, but it is exposed very quickly. Not long after those people entered, someone fell out of the door in a state of embarrassment. His body was covered in blood, his clothes were burnt to black and torn, and his skin was covered with shocking burn marks. The blood-abyss dragon fire pool was too destructive to them, and most of them could not stay in it for too long. Almost as soon as they rushed in, they were forced to exit in embarrassment by the terrifying dragon fire, with a look of shock on their faces.
In comparison, Lin Chen and Ye Qingshuang's performance was much more amazing than them. After the two entered, they did not come out for a long time. The door was quiet, with no screams or any sound of being blown away. This is enough to show that the two of them have steadily begun to experience it.
As for the specific effect of the experience, people outside have no way of knowing, but there is no doubt that compared with those geniuses who just rushed in and escaped in embarrassment, they were not at the same level.
In the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire Pool, the blazing flames surged like an angry giant beast, turning the entire space into a dazzling golden red. Lin Chen sat cross-legged in the middle of the fire pool, his face extremely calm, and he allowed the scorching flames to wrap around his body and burn crazily. The surface of his skin made a "sizzling" sound, and even wisps of white smoke began to rise.
It has to be said that the power of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire Pool is indeed powerful. With Lin Chen's physical strength, the moment he stepped in, he felt an astonishing sense of oppression coming from all directions, almost engulfing him completely. The flames not only burned the body, but also penetrated deep into the meridians along the pores, as if burning every inch of flesh and blood into ashes.
Fortunately, his physical structure was inherently strong, and he finally withstood the first and most violent impact under the crazy burning of the alien flames. After withstanding the first round of attacks, Lin Chen began to reap the benefits - the violent burning power failed to destroy him, but instead was like the most violent hammer, making his body purer and purer as it was forged over and over again. The aura on Lin Chen's body became more and more intenseThe more powerful he is, the more powerful he is, using the blood dragon fire to temper his body, the effect is even better than he expected. His physical body was already extremely strong, but now under the continuous burning of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire, every bone and every meridian became denser and firmer in the tempering of the flames, giving off a faint dark golden sheen.
After withstanding the burning of the Blood Abyss dragon fire, Lin Chen began to try to go one step further - actively absorbing these flames. He circulated the power of dragon blood in his body and sucked the dragon fire surging around him into his meridians. A steady stream of Blood Abyss Dragon Fire surged inside his body, like blazing fire dragons rushing through his meridians. Others would have been burned to the point of breaking off their meridians, but Lin Chen always looked calm. Feeling that the powerful power of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire was being refined by him bit by bit, a satisfied smile appeared on his lips.
Fire patterns began to appear on Lin Chen's body. They were the marks left after the dragon fire of the Blood Abyss burned his body, and they were also proof of absorbing the dragon fire. The more fire patterns there are, the more he absorbs and refines the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire. Red-gold patterns spread across the surface of his skin, like some ancient and mysterious totem. What surprised Lin Chen even more was that the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire not only strengthened his body, but also greatly helped the fire attribute method he practiced. Of course he is proficient in fire-based techniques, but he hasn't practiced them specifically for a long time. In addition, his strength has improved rapidly recently, so fire-based methods are no longer so critical to him. But at this moment, the original fire power contained in the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire poured into his body, and the long-lost fire power was rekindled. Lin Chen could clearly feel that his control over the flames was rising rapidly.
What surprised him even more was that he found that he seemed to be able to control the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire. At the beginning, he simply absorbed the dragon fire into his body to refine it, but he was not able to truly control this power. But as time passed, Lin Chen discovered that he could mobilize the power of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire. With a thought, a red-gold flame jumped out of his palm and flowed gently on his fingertips. This means that as long as he absorbs enough of the origin of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire, he can directly release the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire instead of just passively absorbing it.
Lin Chen's whole body shook suddenly, and a terrible pressure was released from his body. He directly activated the true divine dragon bloodline, the dragon blood boiled all over his body, and his body was covered with a layer of infinite divine dragon armor. After the dragon blood broke through to the level of the true divine dragon, the defensive power of the infinite divine dragon armor naturally increased. The lines on the dragon armor became more complex and the luster became deeper and more restrained. The power of the true divine dragon circulated rapidly in his body. Lin Chen's physical strength suddenly rose to a higher level, and the speed at which he absorbed the dragon fire of the Blood Abyss also skyrocketed. He no longer carefully pulled strands one by one like before, but directly released the heaven-refining furnace in his body, sweeping in the surrounding dragon fire in an almost whale-swallowing manner.
However, it didn't take long for Lin Chen to realize that something was wrong. The speed at which he absorbed the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire was so fast that he sucked up all the essence of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire in a large pool. The fire pool that was originally filled with flames dimmed in the blink of an eye, with only a few weak sparks remaining at the bottom of the pool, and not even a decent flame could emerge.
Lin Chen was stunned for a moment, with a look of embarrassment on his face: "What's going on? Is it just this small?" He thought that the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire would come in a steady stream, enough for him to absorb as much as he wanted, but he never thought that such a big pool would be so inhalable.
At this moment, the corners of the mouth of the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon Will in the Blood Abyss Temple twitched fiercely. Theoretically speaking, the source of dragon fire contained in a blood abyss dragon fire pool is already huge enough. An ordinary prodigy who can absorb one-tenth of the amount in the pool is already extremely talented. It is simply impossible to drain the entire pool of dragon fire.thing. However, Lin Chen seemed to be completely free of this restriction, devouring the origin of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire at an almost crazy speed. What was even more outrageous was that after absorbing so much violent dragon fire, instead of exploding to death, he sat there like nothing happened. This alone is enough to make the Blood Abyss Dragon's will feel incredible.
The will of the Blood Abyss Dragon formed a thought and quietly descended into the assessment space where Lin Chen was. When he saw with his own eyes the powerful aura of fire emanating from Lin Chen's body and the dense fire patterns on his skin, even this well-informed ancient being couldn't help but secretly click his tongue.
After absorbing such a large amount of blood dragon fire origin, Lin Chen always maintained a calm and composed appearance, with steady breathing and calm aura, completely at ease. This scene deeply shocked the Blood Abyss Shenlong. He had seen countless talented and beautiful geniuses, but Lin Chen was definitely the most amazing among them, bar none.
Feeling the coming of the blood abyss dragon's will, Lin Chen raised his head and grinned at him. The smile was bright and calm, with some natural expectations: "Senior, since it is an assessment, it must be tested to the end. I don't have the blood abyss dragon fire anymore - can you transfer some from other places so that I can continue to complete the assessment?"
Hearing this, the Blood Abyss Dragon's will once again twitched the corners of its mouth. Doesn't Lin Chen mean by this, that he wants to absorb more of the Blood Abyss Dragon Fire? He actually stated the reason in such a high-sounding way, as if he was deliberately trying to embarrass him. But the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon thought about it and it seemed that it might not be a bad idea.
Anyway, the performance of the other people who were undergoing the assessment was on a completely different level compared to Lin Chen, and was not worth mentioning at all. Giving resources to those with the greatest potential is an unspoken rule of secret realm experience.
